stop.rule: on the release tick the hero stops (runtime unchanged).  1) every boot in the air flies to its v8 spot and lands (lift <= 2, lift >= 1 until touchdown); 2) then each planted boot that is not on its v8 spot does one low shuffle step (lift 1 for an offset <= 3 rows, else 2) to it, rearmost first; a planted boot never moves while planted; at most one boot changes its view or touches down per tick (the other holds one tick); 3) weight shift: while one boot moves, the torso shifts 1 texel toward the boot that carries the weight; after the last touchdown the body stays 1 row low (dip); the torso shift returns first (one texel per change, while dipped), then the arms step toward N, then - at least settle_ms after the touchdown - the dip returns, then the hair follows; hair / cape move at most one row / texel per tick; 4) the tick after the composite equals v8 (neutral state), the v8 PNG itself is shown.  v06 TIME-BASED CLOCK (v05 counted ticks): every touchdown and every settle change has an event time in ms. A touchdown happens at start + duration, but never before the previous frame (a boot that is still drawn in the air on a frame cannot have landed before it).  The second boot's shuffle starts at the first boot's touchdown time.  A boot held by the one-boot-change-per-tick rule shifts its clock by min(frame time, hold_shift_ms) (v05: a whole frame).  A moving boot never jumps from its start pose to touchdown in one frame: it shows its mid key on that frame first (only at frame times > land / shuffle half durations).  After the last touchdown the settle changes run in v05's order on the event clock: the hair catch-up at the dip time + stop_hair_lag_ms; each torso step, arm step and the dip release at least settle_gap_ms after the previous change (arm steps also arm_step_ms apart, the dip release also settle_ms after the touchdown); the hair follows the dip release by stop_hair_lag_ms.  Each frame draws the state at its own time: at <= 1 frame per settle_gap_ms (60 fps and above) that is at most one change per tick, as in v05; at 30 fps two changes can share a frame (a 16 ms hair lag is shorter than one 33 ms frame, so the hair moves with the body).
stop.settle_clock: event-time-ms (v06; v05: one change per frame)
stop.settle_one_body_change_per_tick: at frame times <= settle_gap_ms (60 fps and above); at 30 fps up to 2
stop.land_keys: [[0, o0, l0, view0, kin0], [500, rdiv(o0, 2), max(1, min(2, l0)), reach, 0], [1000, 0, 1, strike, 0]]; at u >= 1000 the boot is in contact on its spot (stance view for q = land_offset)
stop.shuffle_keys: [[0, o0, 1, toe if the planted view v0 is toe else heelup, 0], [500, rdiv(o0, 2), min(2, 1 + |o0| // 4), hang, 1], [1000, 0, 1, strike, 0]] (v04: the toe start is new)
stop.v10_note: v06 event-clock stop rule unchanged; ONE duration re-tuned: land_ms_max 70 -> 60, so a boot released high in the swing (o -22, lift 4) lands in two 30 fps frames, not three (with 70 ms three 30 fps stops released in early stance took 266.7 ms; Root relaxed exact v07 timing parity: settle <= 250 ms at 30 / 60 fps, <= 300 ms mixed frame times, raised boot <= 100 ms)

restart.rule: on a re-press the planted boot (if two: the one that landed LAST) stays in stance and keeps its window row; the gait phase is re-derived from its offset (q = land_offset - o); the other boot (if planted: lifted now; if in the air: kept where it is) gets a re-planned swing from its current offset / lift to land_offset at its next scheduled landing (the stride sync of 48 px is kept).  The leg that landed last is never the one that lifts first, so the next touchdown is always the other boot.  With both boots in the air the frozen phase resumes.  Arms ease to the gait pose one arm and one pose step per tick until they match it.
restart.replan_keys: [[0, o0, max(1, l0), toe if view0 is a stance view else view0, kin0], [500, rdiv(o0 + land_offset, 2), max(l0, hs), hang, 1], [800, land_offset - 1, max(1, rdiv(hs, 2)), reach, 0], [1000, land_offset, 1, strike, 0]]; hs = clamp(rdiv(3 * remaining_px, stride_px - stance_px), replan_lift_min, replan_lift_max)

leg_rule.rule: n = boot top - (hip 61 + bob).  long (n >= 24): thigh = pick(v8 thigh, 10|15 + rdiv(e * T, T + S)), v8 knee band 1:1, shin = pick(v8 shin, S + rest), the shin slopes onto the cuff (v04 end rule); medium (8 <= n < 24) and folded (n < 8, planned at 8 rows): v06 proportional foreshortening (knee >= 5 rows); a folded leg (and every kick / hang leg) is drawn OVER its boot, every other boot over its leg; boot texels on rows <= 66 + bob are not drawn; kick / hang use the v09 forward knee rows, a shaded shin and v09's knee-over-cuff lean when the shin has < 4 rows; a medium non-tuck shin returns to v8's x (v06)

coat_rule: coat-skirt rows < 66 at (sx, bob); rows >= 66 at (csx, bob + hdy); with hdy = +1 the hem's top row is also drawn at (csx, 66 + bob) so no gap row opens; csx == sx and hdy == 0 on the neutral state
seam_rule: v09: transparent texels at rows >= 41 closed left, right, above and below -> ink
island_rule: v10, after the seam fill: an 8-connected component of the stacked frame that is not the largest, has <= 12 texels and lies wholly on leg-far / leg-near texels (a tucked thigh peeking past the coat edge across a transparent gap) is removed from every layer
